title: BNP Paribas 2014 Corporate film
description: Watch the 2015 corporate film: https://youtu.be/-rRqTZekDOM  Discover BNP Paribas's corporate film 2014: the essential about the Group in less than 3 minutes and in 3D. For more information: http://www.bnpparibas.com/en

asr.full_text: BNP Paribas is one of the most important banking companies in Europe Born at the merger of BNP and Paribas in 2000 BNP Paribas has become a leading bank in the Eurozone BNP Paribas has found its true glory in Europe The bank has deep historical roots The first bank on the market since the merger Since the merger, BNP Par a lot has continued to expand by joining together with other banks today the group employees 190,000 people nearly eighty countries is done with a European Bank the group is strengthening its presence in Asia and the United States it serves twenty-two million clients worldwide individuals small businesses and the United States. It serves twenty two million clients worldwide. Individuals, Small businesses, corporates, and financial institutions. The bank's mission is to serve clients over the long-term by financing their projects and guiding them through the changes affecting them. Another role of the bank is to support economic growth. Risk culture is part of the group's DNA as are business ethics and compliance with the highest standards. It is a responsible bank in every area economic, of course, but also social, civic and environmental. 84% of group employees say they are proud to be part of BNP Paribas, an internationally renowned brand. It is a solid bank. Its capital has more than doubled in five years, and it is well ahead of regulatory requirements. The group's strength is its diversified business model based on 3 core activities Retail Banking With a network of over 7,000 branches worldwide Investments Solutions Which manages clients' savings and assets Corporate and Investment banking serving 15,000 corporates and financial institutions Thanks to the diversity, its business lines and international presence, the group has successfully weathered the crises of recent years. Today, BNP Paribas is one of the most profitable banks in Europe. It is building the world of tomorrow by innovating for the benefit of its clients. PNP Paribas. The Bank for a Changing World.
